title: Well constructed, comfy to walk on. Very greenish blue overall
text: Well constructed, comfy to walk on. Very greenish blue overall. Mmmmm...in person, this is definitely more green/blue than just blue. It's definitely more greenish than I thought or wanted. I'll have to relegate this rug to the prep area of the laundry room. The quality is excellent, which is what I expect from Mohawk. It's soft and feels nice under barefeet, but it's not super thick or fluffy.

product_metadata.title: Mohawk Home Cambridge Denim Area Rug, 5'x8',
features: Mohawk's stain resistant Precision Printed Prismatic Cambridge Area Rug features an abstract design with charming colors
Precision Dye Injected with 100% Polyester (EverStrand PET) cut pile | Felt backing
Easy to Clean | Spot Clean with Water and Mild Detergent
description: Charming and contemporary, mohawk's Cambridge Denim area rugs timeless tile inspired motif is reimagined through a modern abstract, asymmetrical lens and cloaked in a predominantly blue color palette of navy, indigo, gray, silver and white. When it comes to color, the sky is no longer the limit with the infinite possibilities of mohawk's revolutionary prismatic collection. Thoughtfully crafted in the U.S.A. In small batches utilizing mohawk's exclusive precision Dye injected technology, the prismatic collection is redefining printed rugs, literally one original design at a time. Each style in this collection features superior strength, stain resistance, and a cozy soft touch. Consciously created with ever strand yarn, mohawk's exclusive premium recycled polyester produced from post-consumer plastic water bottles, this collection offers options that are as easy on the eyes as they are the world around us.

details.Product Care Instructions: Area rugs should be spot cleaned with a solution of mild detergent and water or cleaned professionally. Regular vacuuming helps rugs remain attractive and serviceable
